summary.intent: Monitor PR #392 for incoming reviews from Copilot and CodeRabbit, then automatically resolve any review comments they raise.
summary.outcome: Copilot's review arrived and flagged a fixture-overwrite bug in test file helpers; the fix was applied to all four helper functions and committed.

repo: PR #392 uses both Copilot and CodeRabbit as automated reviewers; CodeRabbit can be rate-limited (~23 min delays observed).

tests/web-e2e/utils/test-files.ts contains helper functions (createTestMediaFile, createTestImageFile, createTestTextFile, createTestBinaryFile) that copy from committed source fixtures — callers can pass a name matching the fixture, which would cause cleanup to delete the committed file.

code.finding: All four test file helpers (createTestMediaFile, createTestImageFile, createTestTextFile, createTestBinaryFile) needed a guard preventing the output filename from matching the source fixture filename, to avoid committed fixtures being deleted during test cleanup.

workflow: Polling for PR review comments via background Bash tasks with incremental wait intervals is viable but tedious; a /loop or scheduled trigger would be cleaner.
Copilot review comments appear as resolvable inline threads detectable via gh api thread queries.

friction: CodeRabbit was rate-limited for ~23 minutes, requiring extended polling before its review arrived.
No native 'wait for review' mechanism — required manual polling loop with sleep intervals.
Multiple background task outputs had to be read individually to check poll results.
open_items: CodeRabbit's review had not yet arrived by the end of the session — its comments may still need to be resolved.
The /resolve-pr-reviews skill was requested but not yet fully invoked for the CodeRabbit round.
